text: Tojira, a.k.a. the Swamp Queen was a sorceress who magically created the Nightstalkers of Caliman. She discovered dangerous weaponry in various Thran ruins located in a salt marsh in the area of Dakmor. She went on to live there, and waged war on Alaborn.

The Panzerfaust 3 is a modern disposable recoilless anti-tank weapon, which was developed between 1978 and 1985 and put into service by the Bundeswehr in 1992. It was first ordered in 1973 to provide West German infantry with an effective weapon against contemporary Soviet armor, thereby replacing West Germany's aging PzF 44 Light Lanze launchers and the heavy Carl Gustaf 84mm anti-tank recoilless rifle manufactured in Sweden.
Toski is a small Cosmos monster from Kaldheim and the messenger of the gods.
Thrasta, Tempest's Roar, is a dinosaur from an unknown plane.
Toluz, the Clever Conductor, is a human rogue of the Obscura from Capenna. She has also been known as Light's-Out Luz.

The Nailer is a submachine gun available in Battlefield Heroes, introduced in the Punk Heroes 2 bundle. It is available for the Soldier kit of the Royal Army. Unlike other submachine guns, it features an underbarrel shotgun attachment which can be used to engage enemies at close range. Its counterpart is the Leadstorm for the National Army.

Artifacts known as Triskelions were artificial creatures created by Tawnos while he was working as Chief Scholar in Penregon. Used as sentinels and mobile fortifications, They had three legs that could skewer an enemy. They could see in three directions at once and were optimally designed for agility, mobility, and lethality. It proved its usefulness and versatility in many of the later battles between Urza and Mishra.

Tiana is a timid Serra Angel artificer from Dominaria, who has become the guardian and chief engineer of the new Skyship Weatherlight as part of Jhoira's crew. She has a natural affinity with the ship and inherent knowledge of its workings.
Varolz is a fierce troll warrior of the Golgari Swarm on Ravnica. He was chosen as the Golgari maze runner.

The SMG-45 is a submachine gun manufactured by (Land Warfare Resources Corporation), and first displayed at 2015. It is ergonomically based on the AR-15 platform, and uses UMP magazines. It entered full-scale production in 2019 when, in addition to the select-fire military/LE models, pistol braced civilian semi-auto versions became available as well. The SMG-45 appears in Battlefield 2042 as the PBX-45.
Ulrich is the werewolf leader of the Krallenhorde howlpack on Innistrad.
Vial Smasher the Fierce is a legendary goblin berserker from Tarkir.

Ur-Drago was a legendary Elemental of Dominaria. This horrible creature concealed its face behind a curved, steel mask. Its hands and feet were said to end in scorpion-like pincers, and it needed neither to breathe nor to eat, only to kill. He is covered with living rock.

The is an American bolt-action sniper rifle produced by in 2013, chambered in . It was designed and derived from the M98B, with improvements such as folding stock and a capability for barrel and chamber changes in the field. The United States Army adopted the Barrett MRAD under the designation of the MK 22 PSR (Precision Sniper Rifle)
Vadrok, the Thunder-Raptor, is the apex monster of the Raugrin triome on Ikoria.

Umori, the Collector is a legendary ooze from the plane of Ikoria. According to Vivien Reid's studies, Umori harvests the crystals that dot Ikoria and sticks them into its body as a form of decoration. While the crystals stop glowing when picked, Umori can make them glow in batches on command, creating a natural light show. Umori fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
Velomachus Lorehold is one of the five elder dragons from Arcavios that founded Strixhaven. The Lorehold College is named in her honor. She is a master of the magic of order and chaos.

An ice axe (or climbing axe) is a tool used by for climbing or hiking through mountains covered in ice and snow. It consists of a shaft, often angled, to hold the tool, a head, made of steel with a and as tools to dig into the snow and ice, and a spike on the edge of the shaft, to dig into the ground on flat terrain. Ice axes are specialized tools, and can be used as weapons in a pinch due to the various sharp edges to cut into the terrain. During World War I and World War II, the ice axe was used by mountaineering troops of various nations to traverse battlegrounds in the mountains, such as the in both wars or the Norwegian campaign during World War II. In modern conflicts, it used in a similar fashion in battle zones or special operations in alpine or tundra climates.

Vor Golozar was a Gruul raid captain from the Utvara reclamation zone on Ravnica. When the lokopede vehicle of Teysa Karlov was attacked by possessed Gruul, Golozar rescued/captured Crix. Later, he was ordered to accompany her to the Cauldron. Pursued by the same possessed Gruul who attacked the lokopede, Golozar and Crix met Agrus Kos and Pivlic. The four were captured and imprisoned almost instantly after Crix delivered her message. After he was freed from his tethers, Golozar attacked Hauc and almost killed him. When the magelord managed to control one of the newborn dragons, Golozar helped Teysa by riding the other. In the end, the pair was able to defeat Hauc and his dragon. Golozar then steered their dragon to a sharp outcrop, preventing the beast from ever getting out of control by killing her. After the dragon danger was neutralized, Golozar was appointed to be the new Minister of Security in Teysa's service. It is unknown whether Golozar survived the rampage of the nephilim during the events of Dissension. Kos's memories hint that Golozar used to live in the city itself and was even trained for wojek service. However, he left both the academy and the city for living as a wild Gruul, for unknown reasons.

On Lorwyn, Auntie Wort is a shaman and leader of a boggart warden. Wort is not the most stable personality, but she's been around long enough how to keep her boggart younglings out of danger. She always knows which berries can be eaten and which kithkin is easier to trick. Should things go wrong, she can always make more boggarts.
Xandria is a siren on the plane of Theros, who used to be a human scholar from Meletis.

The (English: Tank terror), officially the Raketenpanzerbüchse (English: Rocket armor rifle), was a German rocket launcher designed during World War II. It was a reusable, shoulder-fired rocket launcher that fired a 88mm rocket-propelled grenade. It was heavily based on the American Bazooka.

Zalgadib was an efreet from Suq'Ata on Dominaria. He defended Ramses Overdark's keep, and in exchange he got to eat Ramses, if he was still alive after the end of the efreet's service. It never came to that, because Zalgadib service would have ended 256 years after the year in which Overdark died. Zalgadib himself was killed by Kolo Meha, who had been sent by Tetsuo Umezawa to destroy Overdark's keep.

Élan d'Avenant was an archer squire of the Order of the D'Avenant on Dominaria. To seal an alliance with the town of Hamath, she was to kill Jared Carthalion, who was believed to be a minion of Ravidel. However, before she could kill him, Kristina of the Woods took him away. Élan followed Jared and Kristina to the White Woods, but was prevented from killing Jared when the tree she hid in shook due to Exarch Amadis' magic during the battle against the Calthyn Elves, sending her to the ground. Jared accidentally summoned her during a duel with Ravidel, and the Battlemage incinerated her.

Zilgeth was the leader of Clan Ruby in Storgard in the Ice Age of Dominaria. When a Johtull Wurm attacked Storgard he sacrificed himself to fend off the creature with an Incinerate spell. After his death and burial, Freyalise became the new leader of Clan Ruby.

The QBZ-95B is a shortened carbine variant of the Chinese QBZ-95 assault rifle. Its shortened barrel length improves portability and handling, at the cost of effective range. It is in use by vehicle crewmen, naval crew, and special forces within the Chinese PLA.
Zo-Zu, the Punisher (ZOH-zoo; ), was a reclusive akki of Kamigawa, who made his home wandering in the Sokenzan Mountains.

Zagra is an infamous vampire rogue from Zendikar. Zagras is right-hand to the Kalastria bloodchief Drana. Her word is his bidding, and his loyalty is unquestioning. He has devoted himself to scouring the Skyclaves in search of the means to create new bloodchiefs. This is the source of his loyalty — Drana has promised Zagras that should he find the secret of creation, he will be the first to receive its gifts. His abilities as a rogue are not to be underestimated. He navigates the dangerous hallways of the Skyclaves with ease. Many adventurer parties have woken in the morning to discover their own rogue missing and a nearby Zagras ready to offer his condolences — and his services.
Ysidra is the Adarkar valkyrie who raised Vannemir from the dead to fulfill his destiny and save Terisiare from being destroyed by Heidar.
The Quad Bike, or ATV, is a small, versatile, all-terrain vehicle. __TOC__

Abda and Rigi were a bonded pair of monster-bonders from the plane of Ikoria, known for their independence, survivalist mindset, and deep connection with one another. They deliberately chose to live outside the influence of fortified human settlements and operated autonomously in Ikoria's dangerous wilderness. Abda, a pragmatic and skeptical human, was paired with Rigi, a large, badger-like monster known for his strength and loyalty. Together, they developed a reputation for their tactical precision and ability to survive hostile encounters. Their partnership came to an end during a confrontation near the Ozolith, where both perished while aiding others in their effort to quell growing monster unrest.

Anep is a Khenra warrior and vizier in the service of Hazoret on Amonkhet. Anep first appeared as a named character in the storyline of Amonkhet, where their role as a vizier was introduced, establishing them as a figure of authority within the faith of Hazoret. Later, Anep was made playable in the Foundations Jumpstart product, featured specifically in the Red Zealots deck, reinforcing their association with fiery zeal and combat prowess.
Eshki Dragonclaw is a human warrior from Tarkir. She is the current khan of the Temur Frontier and bound to the spirit dragon Ureni.

The Personal Water Craft (PWC) also known as a jet ski is a high-speed boat designed to transport two people into enemy territory in a stealthy manner. The PWC is unarmed and driver and passenger are extremely vulnerable to attack. However, the passenger in the back can use his primary and secondary weapons along with his grenades. What it lacks in power, it makes up for with speed, agility and efficiency.
Felothar Zanhar is a human warrior from Tarkir. She is the head of House Zanhar, the current khan of the Abzan Houses, and bound to the spirit dragon Betor.
Glissa was a powerful Viridian Elf from Mirrodin who sought to avenge her family's murder. As a compleated Phyrexian, she now serves as Vorinclex's steward.

Grandfather Karlov was the greediest of the Orzhov Oligarchs in life. As a ghost he was a member of the Obzedat, the oligarchy that ruled the Orzhov Syndicate on Ravnica. His house sigil was a serpentine ouroboros.

The RPD (Russian: Ruchnoy Pulemyot Degtyaryova, English: Hand-Held Machine Gun of Degytyaryov) is a Soviet light machine gun designed by Vasily Degtyaryov in 1944. It was meant to replace the DP Machine Gun used by the Red Army during WWII, but it only saw extensive production in the early 1950s. Then, as with many Soviet weapons, RPDs were sold to, and soon manufactured in, many mutually communist countries such as China, North Korea and Vietnam.
Dr. Julius Jumblemorph, previously known as Julius Jameson, is a legendary hybrid creature from Bablovia.
Kirol is a vampire mage-student and athlete at Strixhaven University on Arcavios. They are affectionally called Kiki by Lluwen.
Kotis is a sibsig warrior from Kishla Village in Tarkir. He is the current Fangkeeper (khan) of the Sultai Brood and bound to the spirit dragon Teval.
The Patrol Boat Light (PBL) is a naval vehicle in Battlefield 2: Modern Combat, Battlefield: Bad Company and Battlefield: Bad Company 2.
Musata was a tiger warrior and shaman of her tribe in Efrava on Dominaria.
Pako is a monstrous Elemental Dog from Ikoria. Its bonder is Haldan.
Pol Jamaar, Illusionist, is a human illusion wizard from an unknown plane.

The (Russian: Ручной Противотанковый Гранатомёт 2 Routchnoy Protivotankovy Granatomiot 2, English: Hand-held anti-tank grenade launcher 2) was a Soviet grenade launcher designed in 1949, and was the precursor to the RPG-7. It was known for its relative efficiency, its low production cost, and its simplicity to operate; however being quite inaccurate and having a short range. It fired a 82mm PG-2 high explosive warhead with an effective range of about 100 meters.

Ruby and Carmine Maurer, also known as the Twins of Maurer Estate, are a pair of notorious child vampires descended from the secluded Maurer bloodline in Stensia’s remote outland valleys. They inhabit the crumbling Maurer Estate, an isolated manor surrounded on the edge of human-settled territory. The estate, once the seat of their progenitor Strefan Maurer, is said to still shelter fledgling vampires who cling to its faded grandeur. The twins are infamous for their cruel deception: they appear as helpless, lost girls, dressed in nobles' finery. They lure unwary travelers into the gloom near their ancestral home, where they delight in revealing their true natures and feed without mercy. The wandering monk Reig is among their known victims. Their exact relation to their bloodline's progenitor, Strefan Maurer, is unknown.
Tibor and Lumia Voj were a pair of Izzet League champions on Ravnica. They were a husband and wife team of powerful archmages who fought together in defense of the League's interests.

Experiment 627 is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba, and the first experiment to be created on Earth with limited alien technology. He serves as a minor antagonist in Lilo & Stitch: The Series, and is designed to be a better prototype of Stitch. Unlike the other known experiments (with the exception of Leroy), it is impossible for him to be rehabilitated, so he was dehydrated without ever being given a name or one true place.

The QBB-95 (Chinese: 轻武器步枪班用一九九五 Qīngwuqi Bùqiāng Bānyòng, 1995; English: Light Weapon, Rifle, Squad based, 1995), or the Type 95 LSW (Chinese: 95式班用步枪 95 Shì Bānyòng Bùqiāng; English: Type 95 Squad Rifle), is a Chinese light support weapon designed in 1995 by Norinco, based on the QBZ-95 assault rifle. It uses the 5.8x42mm DPB87 cartridge. It typically uses 75-round drum magazines, although the standard 30-round box magazine is also available. It has a rate of fire around 650 rounds per minute and has an effective range of 600 meters.

Agent E is a minor character of the animated series Phineas and Ferb. She is a bald eagle which works for the O.W.C.A. Her base is supposedly located near where Phineas' grandparents live, as this is where her "nest" is located. She made her debut in the episode "The Ballad of Badbeard".

Ahsoka Tano is a character who appears in the Star Wars franchise, who made her debut appearance in the 2008 animated feature film Star Wars: The Clone Wars, followed by its TV series from 2008-2020. She is a Force-sensitive Togruta, who was the Jedi Padawan of Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars. Since The Clone Wars, Ahsoka has made other appearances in Star Wars related projects, including as the main protagonist of the Disney+ series Star Wars: Ahsoka.

Abraxas (formerly Jalen) was an Alpha-class ISO that evolved into a computer virus and attacked the Tron system in 1989. He is the main antagonist of Tron: Evolution. Abraxas' features are tall and thin, almost sickly in appearance, and his circuitry is yellow, with more of a "cracked" design to his circuits than traditional program circuitry. He wears a hood and a long black cloak over his right shoulder, all outlined with circuits. His primary weapon is his identity disc, and he also possesses a virulent plague touch.

The QBZ-95 (Chinese: 轻武器步枪自动一九九五 Qīngwǔqì Bùqiāng Zìdòng, 1995; English: Light weapon, Rifle, Automatic, 1995), or Type 95 (Chinese: 95式自动步枪 95 Shì Zìdòng Bùqiāng; English: Type 95 Automatic Rifle), is a bullpup style Chinese assault rifle designed in 1995 and manufactured by Norinco and Jianshe Corp (Chinese: 北方工业公司), China South. The updated QBZ-95-1 is in service with the People's Liberation Army, replacing the older QBZ-95. The weapon uses a proprietary 30 round magazine, has a rate of fire of around 650 rounds per minute and an effective range of 400 meters, with a maximum range of 600 meters. It also has a specialized and optional 4x telescopic sight. Variants of the weapon include the QBB-95 light support weapon and the QBZ-95B carbine.

Alexandra Margarita "Alex" Russo-Penwulf is the protagonist of the Disney Channel Original Series, Wizards of Waverly Place and a recurring character in Wizards Beyond Waverly Place. She is the only daughter and middle child of Theresa and Jerry Russo. She is Justin Russo's younger sister and Max Russo's older sister. As the middle child and only daughter, she is sly, outgoing, sneaky, and sometimes rude to her family and friends. Alex usually underachieves when it comes to school and wizard training. She often gets into trouble because of her constant schemes (usually involving magic). Alex is smart but not hardworking, much to the dismay of her older brother, Justin. Alex became a full wizard in Wizards of Waverly Place: The Movie, but later makes a wish through the Stone of Dreams to turn back time which, in turn, made her a student again (it would take a little while longer for her to achieve that title again). In 2008, AOL named her the twentieth greatest witch in television history. Selena Gomez, who portrays Alex, is one of the only two cast members to appear in every single episode of the series to date; the only other cast member to appear in all episodes that have aired so far is David Henrie, who portrays Justin Russo. Alex has also appeared in The Suite Life on Deck and Hannah Montana. At the end of the series, Justin came out of the tunnel first which meant he won but he made an explanation that Alex helped him get out of a vine. So, Alex became the family wizard

Airplane Jane is an airplane pilot from the TV show TaleSpin. This hippo learned to fly from Baloo (it reputedly took her a minute), and she shares almost the same mannerisms and behavior as her former mentor. Jane was once a finishing school attendee with Princess Grace of Walla-Walla-Bing-Bang, but "never finished". Despite her show-offish attitude (she never misses a chance to rub it to Baloo that she is the better pilot) and often sneaky, competitive nature, she also has a heart of gold underneath and would help out a friend in need. Her only appearance is in the episode "Waiders of the Wost Tweasure".

Alice and Desmond Ravenson are witches who appear in the Disney Jr. animated series Vampirina. They are Phoebe Ravenson's parents, who are national heroes of Transylvania for saving an entire town from an attack of haunted weeds.

The M7 Priest was an American self-propelled artillery vehicle that was designed and produced during World War II. It was used mostly by American forces in Europe, but British forces also used them in North Africa. It boasted 51mm armor and a 105mm Howitzer, and could go at speeds of around 15–20 km/h.

Aisha is a character from Marvel Comics, who appears within the Marvel Cinematic Universe. She was first mentioned in the second episode of the Disney+ series, Ms. Marvel and made her debut in the third episode. She is portrayed by Mehwish Hayat. Aisha is the mother of Sana and the husband of Hasan. She was a member of the Clandestines, a group of Djinn who were exiled onto Earth. She and her fellow Djinn, sought a way to return back to their home, the Noor Dimension. During her time on Earth, she fell in love with a man named Hasan, and bore his daughter, under the British Occupied India. She fled with her family to resettle in Pakistan during the Partition of India, but met the end of her fate at the hands of Najma, who killed Aisha, for betraying their group. It was through Aisha’s lineage, that her great-granddaughter gained her powers, and would eventually go on to become the super heroine, Ms. Marvel. Aisha was originally created by writer, G. Willow Wilson, and artists, Takeshi Miyazawa & Adrian Alphona.
Alvin Yasbeck was a human who donned the superhero guise of Mondo-Man in Mighty Ducks.

Amity Blight is a recurring character in the Disney Channel animated series The Owl House. She is a prodigious young witch who started out as an antagonist before reforming herself and reassessing her outlook on life as the show progressed. She is the youngest child of the Blight family, and Luz's girlfriend.

The King George V-class battleship was a class of British battleships designed in during the 1930s and built during the first half of World War II. They were the most modern British battleships of the era. Five such ships were built and commissioned, the King George V (1940), Prince of Wales (1941), Duke of York (1941), Howe (1942), and Anson (1942). Of the five, only Prince of Wales was sunk along with the battlecrusier HMS Repulse after attacks by Japanese aircraft off Malaya on December 10, 1941.

Ammit is a Marvel Comics character and one of the main antagonists in Moon Knight. Much like the Asgardians are the gods from the Norse pantheon, she is a Crocodile goddess from the Egyptian pantheon. She used to judge souls that were about to enter the afterlife and devoured those not worthy of everlasting peace. However, at some point, she slipped into a more villainous role, killing mortals for crimes they may or may not commit, regardless of how young they are or how noble they are. As a result she was imprisoned in a ushabti by the Ennead Council and her avatar Alexander the Great. Arthur Harrow is her most loyal servant, and Moon Knight is her enemy, as he and Khonshu fight to stop her from killing innocents. This version of the mythological Ammit was created by Alexander Irvine and Russell Braun.

Amy Madden is the lead protagonist of the Disney Channel Original Series The Villains of Valley View. She is a supervillain, posing as an ordinary girl. Her supervillain name is Havoc. Like the rest of her family, besides Vic, Amy has superpowers and is a full blown villain. Since destroying Onyx, she is now the Supreme Leader of All Villains. She is portrayed by Isabella Pappas.

Ansem, Seeker of Darkness is the main antagonist of Kingdom Hearts and the "Reverse/Rebirth" mode in Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories. He is the Heartless of Xehanort, and retains the dark "guardian" which belonged to his original self.

Reactive Armor is a type of vehicle armor addition that reacts to the impact of anti-vehicle weapons by way of exploding. The explosion disrupts and deflects the projectile, preventing catastrophic damage to the rest of the vehicle. In Battlefield 3, the term is also used for slat armor, which defeats anti-vehicle weapons by causing them to detonate prematurely, well away from the actual skin of the vehicle. The vehicle's primary armor can withstand the diffused impact much better than it could a direct hit.

Antauri is the black monkey in the Super Robot Monkey Team Hyperforce Go! television series. He is a black monkey for seasons one and two, but later the silver monkey in seasons three and four, and the second-in-command of the Hyperforce. Antauri is very calm and collected and cares greatly for his friends, willing to protect them with his life. He often acts as a leader and mentor, and is serious about training. He's not a big fan of video games, and he's a vegetarian. He teaches Chiro how to control the Power Primate, and also gives spiritual advice to the rest of the Team. He has a father-son relationship with Chiro; his closest friends are Gibson and SPRX-77. He spends most of his time either meditating or patrolling Shuggazoom City. He pilots Brain Scrambler Pilot 2, which forms the head of the Super Robot. It's revealed in "Circus of Ooze" that his favorite circus/movie snack is cotton candy. His main weapons are his ghost claws and the attack he often uses called Monkey Mind Scream. He heavily relies on the Power Primate and believes that Chiro is the Chosen One.

Anga is a character who appears in the Disney Jr. television series The Lion Guard. She is a martial eagle who took over as the Lion Guard's Keenest of Sight when Ono becomes vision-impaired due to his injury while trying to save Bunga from Ushari beginning in Season 3.
Andres Padillo is a character in Upside-Down Magic. He is portrayed by Max Torina and an abnormal Flyer.

The Precision Barrel is a weapon attachment featured in Battlefield Play4Free. It increases the Projectile Velocity of the weapon. All classes except the Recon class get an increase of 250 velocity with the former getting an increase of 200 velocity.
Annie the Giant is a character introduced in Mickey Mouse Funhouse.
The Armored Cards are the Red Queen's minions in Tim Burton's adaptation of Alice in Wonderland. All of the cards in this version are the same color same, suit and battle-hardened.

Arnold Alois Schwarzenegger is an Austrian-American actor, producer, businessman, politician, author and former professional bodybuilder, who had served two terms as the from 2003 until 2011. He is best known for his titular role as the Terminator/T-800 in the , the sixth () having been released internationally by Disney following the merger of Disney and 20th Century Studios. His other well-known film roles include playing Alan "Dutch" Schaefer in , Douglas Quaid/Carl Hauser in , Harry Tasker in , and Howard Langston in . For Disney, he portrayed Prince Hapi in Around the World in 80 Days. He was also spoofed by Genie in Aladdin, and his Terminator role was spoofed by Genie again in the TV series. Additionally, Arnold Mousenegger in the Chip 'n Dale Rescue Rangers series was named after and based on him. He was also referenced briefly in Homeward Bound, as during the scene where Chance and Shadow are being pursued by a hungry mountain lion, Chance refers to the feline predator as "Arnold Schwarzenkitty". Additionally, in Beverly Hills Chihuahua, during the scene where after Monte and his tribe of Chihuahuas save Chloe and Delgado from three mountain lions, he quotes, "Come with us if you want to live," a reference to one of Schwarzenegger's titular character's very famous lines: "Come with me if you want to live," from . He was also mentioned in Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Day, as well as in the K.C. Undercover episode "Out of the Water and Into t
The Precision Stock is a weapon attachment featured in Battlefield Play4Free. It increases the accuracy while aiming down the sights (ADS).
Arthur is the main antagonist of Disney's 2018 animated feature film Ralph Breaks the Internet. He's an insecurity virus created by Double Dan to disseminate any infection around the Internet.
Apothecary Gary is a character that appears in the 2019 Disney Channel animated series Amphibia. He is a formerly evil fungus that is able to take over the mind of his host.

Ashitaka is the main protagonist in the 1997 Studio Ghibli film Princess Mononoke. He is the prince of an Emishi village who, after being cursed by a demon boar Nago, travels to the west to seek a cure and prevent his curse from falling onto another.

The Predator Barrel is a weapon attachment featured in Battlefield Play4Free. It improves a weapon's range and increases accuracy. It increases velocity with assault rifles, LMGs, and SMGs by 150 and with sniper rifles by 100.

Asterius is a supporting character in the 2008 Disney/Walden Media adaptation of The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian. He is a huge, brown, male, elderly minotaur and a member of the Old Narnians. Like the other Old Narnians, he longed to see their homeland returned to its former glory.
Bahuka is a tiki statue from the Timon & Pumbaa TV series who makes his first and only appearance in the episode "Oahu Wahoo". He temporarily intimidates Timon into obeying his every command.
Babel Fish is a useful creature from The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy. It was created by Douglas Adams.

Poison Gas was a cut weapon in a very early version of Battlefield 2: Special Forces. There is very little information of the weapon, the only evidence of Poison Gas is that it was supposed to poison enemies when they were underwater. The underwater levels, diving, and Poison Gas were cut. zh:毒气
Batroc is a supervillain who uses his jumping abilities for crime. Batroc was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.
Barriss Offee is a character who appears in the Star Wars franchise. She is a Mirialan Jedi Knight who fell to the dark side of the Force and became an Imperial Inquisitor.
Beppo the Gorilla is a monstrous ape that has antagonized Mickey a few times.

The Radar Tower is an emplacement in Battlefield 1942, appearing on the map Battle of Britain. It functions as a flak-gun with radar. The emplacement can be spawned upon unless destroyed. The main advantage to other anti-air emplacements is that the player can see the planes within a five second's notice. The emplacement can take up to four bombs to destroy. There are four emplacements along the factory that make up the targets for the Luftwaffe in Battle of Britain. All the radar towers are named in-game differently. Grid Coordinates are the map in-game. * Clacton-on-Sea - Far Left side of the map at the map grid coordinates B3. * East Harwich - left side of the bridge on the map at the map grid coordinates E4 * West Harwich - Right side of the bridge on the map at the map grid coordinates F4 * Felixstowe - Far Right side of the map at the map grid coordinates G4

Beck is the main protagonist of Tron: Uprising. Trained by Tron to lead a resistance against General Tesler and CLU, Beck takes on the identity of Tron to inspire the masses, gaining the label "The Renegade" in the process.

William "Billy" Butcherson is a supporting character in Disney's 1993 film Hocus Pocus and its 2022 sequel, portrayed by actor Doug Jones. He was the obsession of Winifred Sanderson, whom she poisoned after she believed he cheated on her with her youngest sister, Sarah. In 1993, Butcherson was brought back to life as a zombie by Winifred as an act to retrieve her spell book.

Camilo Madrigal is a supporting character in Disney's 2021 animated feature film Encanto. He is the middle child of Pepa and Félix Madrigal, younger brother of Dolores and older brother of Antonio. The proclaimed "theatre kid" of the Madrigals, Camilo was gifted with the ability to shapeshift.

and Rifle Scope]] The RFB (Rifle, Forward-Ejection, Bullpup) is a gas-operated semi-automatic rifle, manufactured by Kel-Tec Industries of Florida. The rifle is fully ambidextrous and is chambered for the 7.62x51 NATO/.308 Winchester cartridge. The RFB has a unique forward ejection system which gives it its name; spent casings are ejected into a tube over the barrel and then gently dropped out of an opening near the muzzle. The RFB Hunter variant features a 24" stainless steel barrel.

The Cat Bus is a supporting character in My Neighbor Totoro and a studio icon for Studio Ghibli. The Cat Bus is first seen making its bus rounds. Mei and Satsuki are waiting at the bus stop alongside Totoro, when the Cat Bus arrives. Totoro boards the Catbus, and they leave the station. The second time the Cat Bus is seen is after Mei gets lost attempting to take corn to her sick mother in the hospital. Satsuki has been searching for a while, when she finally resorts to seeing Totoro. He calls the Catbus for her, and he takes her to Mei. After Mei has been found, he brings them to the hospital to bring their mother the corn. It is shown that the Catbus has others in his species, as shown by the exclusive short film "Mei and the Baby Cat Bus", all modeled after passenger vehicles. It is implied that the Baby Cat Bus is his child.

A centaur is a mythical creature that is a composite race of creatures, part human and part horse. They are depicted with the hindquarters of a horse attached to the torso of a human joined at the waist to the horse's withers, where the horse's neck would be. This half-human and half-animal composition has led many writers to treat them as liminal beings, caught between the two natures, embodied in contrasted myths, both as the embodiment of untamed nature. They can be both male or female; however, female ones are also called centaurettes.
Cedric the Sorcerer is the former main antagonist of the Disney Jr. series Sofia the First. He is the Royal Sorcerer of Enchancia.

A Potato Grip is an enlarged grip for mounting on a weapon's bottom attachment rail. One notable model is produced by FAB-Defense of Israel, featuring ribbing to assist with countering recoil and preventing the user's grip hand from heating up, therefore preventing "barrel burn", and an inner mount to insert a tactical flashlight, or possibly a laser sight.
Cecilia is a friendly sea serpent living on Pirate Princess Island with the Pirate Princess in the Disney Jr. animated series Jake and the Never Land Pirates.

Dr. Cecilia Reyes is a Marvel Comics character who appeared as the main antagonist in The New Mutants, played by Alice Braga. She is a medical doctor and a Mutant who can generate force fields. Cecilia Reyes was created by Scott Lodbell and Carlos Pacheco.
Chandra is a character and the main antagonist of Upside-Down Magic. She is the human manifestation of Shadow Magic.

The RPK-12 is a proposed light machine gun variant of the AK-12 assault rifle. It is a modernization of the older RPK-74, and like the AK-12, is fitted with multiple accessory rails and lightweight polymer furniture.

Cere Junda is the main protagonist of the Star Wars comic book series Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple and the deuteragonist of the 2019 video game Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order. She is a former Jedi Knight during the Clone Wars. She took on Trilla Suduri as her apprentice and the two survived Order 66. Suduri turned to the dark side and became the Inquisitor known as the Second Sister. Junda became a mentor to another survivor of the purge, Cal Kestis.

Chopsuey, also known as Experiment 621, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba, and the main antagonist of the video game Disney's Stitch: Experiment 626. He has all of Stitch's powers but is less capable. He is jealous of all the attention that Stitch gets.

Christopher D'Olier Reeve was an American actor, film director, producer, screenwriter, author, and activist, whose only Disney-related roles included one of the Japanese pole vaulters in episode 221 of The Muppet Show; a guest appearance on The Muppet Show in episode 418; Frederick Dallas/Phillip Brent in the 1992 Touchstone Pictures film Noises Off, and a cameo appearance in The Muppets Go Hollywood, contending with Charles Durning for a chance to dance with Miss Piggy. He also made guest appearances on Sesame Street in 2000. He also appeared in the Road to Avonlea episode "A Dark and Stormy Night" as Robert Rutherford. Born in New York City and raised in Princeton, New Jersey, Reeve became interested in acting at the age of nine and studied at Cornell University and the Juilliard School. He made his Broadway debut in 1976 with A Matter of Gravity. His major breakthrough came with the titular role of Superman/Clark Kent in the 1978 film and its three sequels during the 1980s. His other films included Somewhere in Time, The Bostonians, Street Smart, The Remains of the Day, The Rose and the Jackal, and Village of the Damned. While struggling to find film work, he continued to find steady work in theater with shows, like The Front Page, The Marriage of Figaro, Fifth of July, and The Winter's Tale. On May 27, 1995, Reeve broke his neck when he was thrown from a horse during an equestrian competition which paralyzed him from the shoulders down, and he depended on a ventilator to

Passive Radar guidance allows missiles to track a target by receiving radar emissions from the launch vehicle that bounce off the target, therefore requiring the launch vehicle to maintain a radar 'lock' on the target until the missile impacts.

Chirrut Îmwe is a character in the 2016 Lucasfilm movie Rogue One: A Star Wars Story. He was a blinded spiritual warrior-monk. Alongside his friend and protector, Baze Malbus, he and other members of the Rebellion assisted Jyn in her mission to steal the Death Star plans. Although he did not have a connection to the Force, Chirrut was a strong believer in it and the ways of the Jedi, carrying a simple staff and traditional lightbow bowcaster, contrasting greatly with his partner's more pragmatic personality. His devotion to spirituality helped him overcome his blindness and become a formidable warrior.

The Chernabog is a character featured in the ABC fantasy-drama series, Once Upon a Time, appearing in the episode "Darkness on the Edge of Town". The Chernabog was released from the Sorcerer Hat. Here, Chernabog is still a demon, but is always referred to as "The Chernabog", and has a satyr-like appearance with its dark aura. It seeks the person with the heart that has the darkest potential, and it is not necessarily a person who had done bad things but simply a person who had the potential to be evil. This can be shown by the Chernabog trying to get Emma and not Regina; the reason being that Emma, being a child of a couple's True Love, can either be a mighty hero or a terrible villain. The Chernabog also went after Maleficent in the past after she along with the other Queens of Darkness and Rumplestiltskin attempted to steal the Dark Curse. It may have been because Maleficent was pregnant at the time, and thus carried a heart with the greatest potential for darkness. In Storybrooke, the beast was defeated by tricking it over the town line and since the creature was made of pure dark magic, it was completely destroyed after crossing over.
Chessy Cheshire is the secondary antagonist of Descendants: Wicked Wonderland. She is the daughter of the Cheshire Cat.

The QJZ89 is heavy machine gun used by the People's Liberation Army. It fires the 12.7x108mm cartridge, and is either used as a vehicle-mounted weapon, or as an infantry weapon manned by teams of three.

Clink, also known as Experiment 086, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to capture and confine enemies inside of him.

Cinnamon Teal is an antagonist from the DuckTales franchise, that debuted in "Spies in Their Eyes". She is a spy whose greatest asset is her gaze, with which she mesmerizes others to do her bidding. She sometimes teams up with her cousin, Ho, whose place in her schemes is that of muscle mass. Despite only appearing in one episode in the original series, she was given more prominence in printed media.
Cloverleaf is Gladstone Gander's superheroic alter ego in the Ultraheroes story arc.

The Modular Advanced Armed Robotic System (MAARS) is an unmanned ground vehicle developed by Qinetiq. Designed for reconnaissance, surveillance, and target acquisition (RSTA) to increase security at forward locations. MAARS is armed with an M240B machine gun and four M203 grenade launcher tubes on a 360 degree rotating turret. It carries 450 rounds of ammunition and four grenade rounds. The MAARS is depicted in Battlefield 4 as the RAWR (Remote Assisted Weaponized Robot). __TOC__
Chrysta is a feisty Crystal Fairy, who appears in the Disney Jr. animated series Sofia the First. She is Sofia's trainer for becoming a Protector of the EverRealm.
The Cloak-Bot is one of several frog-bot models produced and was sent to earth by King Andrias to eliminate Anne Boonchuy, and is a major antagonist in the third season of Amphibia.

Colleen Wing is a Marvel Comics character that appears in Iron Fist, played by Jessica Henwick. She trained under the Sensei Bakuto, making her part of the Hand. However, she forgoes her membership of the criminal organization to help Danny Rand, and thus became Danny's partner in his adventures, helping him protect the innocent and fight the forces of evil. She is an expert martial artist and a skilled swordswoman. She runs her own dojo in New York City, which was given to her by Bakuto to train more members of the Hand. Colleen Wing was created by Doug Moench, Larry Hama, and Neal Adams.

The Ford Mustang is a civilian car that has been manufactured by the Ford Motor Company since 1964 to the present. It is used by Law Enforcement primarily for interstate speeding enforcement and is well-renowned as a fast and powerful muscle car. The Ford Mustang appears in Battlefield Hardline as the Police Interceptor. __TOC__
Crackle is Princess Vivian's pet dragon who appears in the Disney Jr. animated series Sofia the First.
The Cowardly Lion is a huge, but frightful beast who lives in the Land of Oz. He is one of the protagonists of the Wizard of Oz book series and movies as well as a friend of Dorothy Gale.
The Corpse Family is a family of zombies that live in Halloween Town and one of the supporting characters of the 1993 stop-motion Disney film, The Nightmare Before Christmas.
Reinforced Vehicle is a vehicle specialization featured in the Battlefield series.

Cordelia the Conjuror is a character who appears in the Disney Jr. animated series Sofia the First. She is Cedric's older sister and a sorceress, able to cast spells like the rest of her family members.

Crispy is a dragon who appears in the Sofia the First episode "Bad Little Dragon" as the main antagonist. His character appears to be modeled after old-time mobsters - more specifically, Baby Face Nelson.

The Crane is the main character from the former Tokyo Disneyland attraction Meet the World. As her name suggests, the Crane is a Japanese crane (Grus Japonensis) that takes two children back in time to the ancient periods of Japan.

A pickup truck is a light duty truck having an enclosed cab and an open cargo area with low sides and tailgate. Once a work tool with few creature comforts, in the 1950s consumers began purchasing pickups for lifestyle reasons and by the 1990s less than 15 per cent of owners reported use in work as the pickup truck's primary purpose. Today in North America the pickup is now mostly used like a passenger car. Dafne Keen Fernández is a British-Spanish actress. After making her debut as Ana "Ani" Cruz Oliver on the television series The Refugees from 2014 to 2015, she garnered recognition and praise for her role as X-23 in the 2017 20th Century Studios film . She received several awards, including an Empire Award for Best Newcomer, and nominations for a Critics' Choice Award and a Saturn Award. For Disney, she portrayed Jecki Lon in the 2024 Disney+ series Star Wars: The Acolyte, reprised her role as Laura Kinney/X-23 in the Marvel Cinematic Universe film Deadpool & Wolverine, and portrayed Artemis in the third season of Percy Jackson and the Olympians.

Cupid (known in Greek as Eros) is the Olympian God of love and passion whose main duty is to inspire love in others by shooting them with his magic arrows which can make anyone fall in love with the first person they see.

Dark End is an alien experiment who appeared in the third season of the Stitch! anime as a minor antagonist. Dark End was created by Delia using similar genetic blueprints to that of Stitch and required Stitch's power cell to complete their creation, although a new power cell stolen from Jumba was ultimately used. It is because of this that Dark End does not fall into Jumba's numbering system. Delia made Dark End as a combatant in order to defeat Stitch. This character's gender differs between dubs, being a female in the Japanese original and a male in the English dub. As a result, this article will use "they/them" pronouns for consistency purposes.

The Mark 12 SPR (Special Purpose Rifle; formerly Special Purpose Receiver) is an American Designated Marksman Rifle. Essentially a heavily modified DMR variant of the M16, the SPR was created due to requests for a special forces rifle with a greater range than that of the M4 carbine while still possessing a short barrel length. The SPR is about five inches shorter than the standard M16A4, and has an effective range of 500 meters. It is currently in use with United States special forces, particularly those of the United States Army and Navy, as well as having seen limited use by the United States Marine Corps. The Mod 1 SPR appears in Battlefield Hardline as the RO933 M1, equipped with an A2 buttstock.

David Michael "Dave" Bautista, Jr. is a Greek-Filipino-American mixed actor, martial artist, bodybuilder, and retired professional wrestler, who is best known for his time in (World Wrestling Entertainment, Inc.), where he performed under the ring name "Batista" and became a six-time . For Disney, he portrayed Drax the Destroyer in the 2014 Marvel sci-fi action film Guardians of the Galaxy, and reprised this role in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2, Avengers: Infinity War, Avengers: Endgame, Thor: Love and Thunder, and Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3. He also played The Streamer, serving as a spokesperson for the Disney Bundle and Disney Streaming services (Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+), as well as Victor "Vic" Manning in the 2019 Fox buddy cop comedy film . He played Garrett in FX's What We Do in the Shadows.

Danielle Moonstar is a Marvel Comics character who appeared in The New Mutants. She is a Native American mutant who can cast illusions. Danielle Moonstar was created by Chris Claremont and Bob McLeod.

Davy Jones is a main antagonist in the Pirates of the Caribbean franchise, first appearing in Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest. He is based on a character of the same from nautical folklore, whose name is used as a euphemism for a watery grave. Once a great sailor who "ran afoul of that which vexes all men" through the sea goddess Calypso, Davy Jones was condemned for eternity as the devil of the deep, as his legends associated with the Flying Dutchman and Davy Jones' Locker. After being forsaken by Calypso, Davy Jones told the first Brethren Court how to bind Calypso into human form. Jones also carved out his own heart and locked it away in the Dead Man's Chest, keeping the key with him at all times. He became a nightmarish creature, the legendary captain of the Flying Dutchman and ruler of the ocean depths. A squid-like beast known as the Kraken brought more souls into joining Jones' crew, eventually becoming a part of the cursed ship itself. Thirteen years after his bargain with Davy Jones, Captain Jack Sparrow searches for the Dead Man's Chest to use as leverage to satisfy his debt to Jones. Ultimately, Lord Cutler Beckett of the East India Trading Company came into possession of the still-beating heart, forcing Jones and his crew to do his bidding. With the Flying Dutchman under Beckett's control, Davy Jones led Beckett's Armada in the fight against the fourth Brethren Court. The Rolls-Royce armored car was a British armored car developed in 1914 and used in World War I and in the early part of World War II. During World War I, the Royal Naval Air Service (RNAS) of the United Kingdom created the RNAS Armoured Car Section to develop their land presence, and is for a time UK's only mechanized land force. In September 1914, all available Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost chassis were requisitioned to be used as the basis for a new armored car design. 120 Rolls-Royce armored cars were built over the course of the war. The armored car appears in Battlefield 1 as the RNAS Armored Car.

Della Duck is an anthropomorphic duck created by Ted Osborne and Al Taliaferro. As the only daughter of Hortense McDuck and Quackmore Duck, she is the twin sister of Donald Duck and mother to Huey, Dewey, and Louie. Della was first referenced in the 1937 comic adaptation of the 1938 animated short Donald's Nephews, acting as the story’s inciting incident. She seldom appeared thereafter. In the few stories to have acknowledged the character, namely those by cartoonist [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evert_Geradts Evert Geradts], she was established as having blonde hair and a background in aviation. Della made her animated debut in the television series DuckTales, first appearing at the end of the two-part season one finale “The Shadow War!” on August 18, 2018. She is depicted as a seasoned pilot and adventurer, having once accompanied Donald and their uncle, Scrooge McDuck, on globe-trotting expeditions. The mystery surrounding her disappearance serves as the emotional core of the show’s narrative. Matt Youngberg developed the character’s ensemble to include an aviator hat, goggles, bomber jacket, blue scarf, brown pants, and a prosthetic leg.
Derek Blunt is an eagle who is the greatest agent in the history of S.H.U.S.H., as well as the arch enemy of Phineas Sharp in Darkwing Duck.

Dexter Riley is the protagonist of a trilogy of films, beginning with The Computer Wore Tennis Shoes, followed by Now You See Him, Now You Don't and The Strongest Man in the World. He is a student at Medfield College who goes a series of acquiring various superpowers through bizarre, unlikely means. Every year, he has to help save the college from bankruptcy, through various means of scientific inventions or discoveries.

The Pieper Revolving Carbine is a Belgian rifle which utilizes the gas seal system from the Nagant M1895 revolver. It saw use by the Rurales police force near the end of the 19th century. (A Nagant-produced revolver carbine was also used by Russia's own Border Guard.) The gun's wooden barrel shroud provides a sleeker profile than the earlier .

Deadpool (real name Wade Winston Wilson) is a character originating from Marvel Comics who is an anti-hero known for his ability to break the fourth wall. He returns as the titular protagonist in the film Deadpool & Wolverine, set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, after appearing in the X-Men Cinematic Universe films X-Men Origins: Wolverine, Deadpool, and Deadpool 2. He is portrayed by Ryan Reynolds in all of the aforementioned appearances. Deadpool was created by Rob Liefeld and Fabian Nicieza.

Michael "Mike" Peterson is a character who appears in the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. episodes "Pilot", "The Bridge", "The Magical Place", "T.R.A.C.K.S.", "End of the Beginning", "Nothing Personal", "Ragtag", "Beginning of the End", "Afterlife", "The Frenemy of My Enemy", and "The Dirty Half Dozen". He is the first person to bear the mantle of Deathlok. Deathlok was created by Doug Moench and Rich Buckler. Michael Peterson was created by Len Kaminski and James Fry.
Dewdrop is a minor antagonist in the 2020 Disney/Pixar animated feature film, Onward. She serves as the leader of a gang of hostile motorcycle fairies known as the "Pixie Dusters".
The Queen of the Battlefield is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. It is unlocked upon obtaining ten kills with the Heavy Machine Gun.
Deep Dark Secret is a minor character in Disney•Pixar's 2024 animated feature film Inside Out 2. He is a dark, beefy, gorilla-like figure who represents Riley's deep, dark secret.

Demyx, the Melodious Nocturne (夜想のしらべ, Yasō no Shirabe, lit. Nocturnal Poem), is Rank IX within Organization XIII. He controls water, and uses his weapon, the sitar, as a musical instrument to make water fight for him in battle. He commands the [http://kingdomhearts.wikia.com/wiki/Dancer Dancer] Nobodies.

Djinns are magical creatures (issued from North African mythology) that are more commonly known as Genies. One was featured as a villain in the American Dragon: Jake Long episode "The Talented Mr. Long" and another made a cameo in "The Halloween Bash" (both from Season 1). Djinns do not appear in Season 2.
The RAC Armored Car is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. Describing the Romfell Armored Car, it is unlocked upon obtaining fifteen kills with Armored Cars.

Dr. Stephen Vincent Strange (known as Doctor Strange) is a superhero from Marvel Comics. He is a neurosurgeon who suffered nerve damage to his hands in a car crash. He sought out the Ancient One, hoping to cure his disability, but abandons that notion after being taught to use and utilize magic from the Ancient One, eventually becoming the Sorcerer Supreme, until he blipped and the title was passed on to Wong. He debuts in the Marvel Cinematic Universe as the eponymous protagonist of the 2016 film Doctor Strange, and made subsequent appearances in the following films of the franchise. Doctor Strange was partaking in the battle between the Avengers and Thanos' army in Avengers: Infinity War, where the team lost and Doctor Strange was one of the thousands who was a victim of the Blip, before being restored to life five years later. Following the multiversal crisis in late 2024, Doctor Strange attended the wedding of his former girlfriend and blip survivor, Christine Palmer. Stephen saved America Chavez, with the help of Wong, learning she had the ability to travel the multiverse and who was being hunted by the Scarlet Witch for her powers, so Wanda could travel to a different universe to be with her sons. Strange and America come across varaints of him along the way. After landing on earth-838, Stephen finally gets closure with an alternate Christine, after Wanda's defeat, eventually gaining a third eye from dreamwalking and works with a sorcerer to undo his incursion he caused

Dom Gordo of Ghent is a character in Disney's 1985-91 television series Adventures of the Gummi Bears. Dom Gordo is a wizard of Ghent who was blackmailed by Duke Igthorn. Later, he took part in a magical duel against Zummi Gummi. Since then, he has made amends with Zummi and currently resides in Ghent.

Dorkifier, also known as Experiment 122, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to zap a pink ray that changes anyone's appearance into something ridiculous. Also, the new dorky clothes cannot be taken off the victim unless the horns are rotated upside-down, after which every victim will automatically be restored to normal. He appears in the Stitch! anime.

Putilov Garford Armored Car is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1, introduced in the Battlefield 1: In the Name of the Tsar expansion. It is unlocked upon obtaining ten kills with the Putilov-Garford.
Doubtfinder, also known as Doubt, is the main antagonist of the Disney Kingdoms series Figment 2. It is the nightmarish manifestation of the Dreamfinder's doubts and fears.

Dot the Dragon is a dragon, who appeared in the Muppet Babies episode "Sir Kermit the Brave". Her full name is Belladotta of Sweaterhelm, but nobody calls her that (except her mom when she gets angry).
Drake Stone is a British celebrity illusionist and a major antagonist from The Sorcerer's Apprentice.

The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chauchat-Ribeyrolles_1918_submachine_gun Chauchat-Ribeyrolles 1918] is a weapon based on the RSC 1917 semi-automatic rifle mechanism made by some of the same creators behind Chauchat: Chauchat, Sutter, Ribeyrolles, and the Gladiator factory (often abbreviated CSRG). It was presented in 1918 as a "pistolet-mitrailleur" (machine-pistol) for use as firing port weapon by the French tank crews. Going through several trials, the results were satisfactory but the weapon was too powerful for the intended self-protection use.
Dracula (also known as Count Dracula) is a famous literary (as well as partly historic) character who has made several appearances in a variety of Disney and Marvel properties.
Drake Von Vladstone, better known as Count Dracula Duck is the final boss in the video games DuckTales and DuckTales: Remastered. His full real name was first mentioned in the remastered version.
EVE (which stands for Extraterrestrial Vegetation Evaluator) is the deuteragonist of the 2008 Disney•Pixar animated feature film WALL-E.

Recoil Direction is a special weapon customization option (an "Attachment") in Battlefield 1, which changes the direction of the recoil pattern. Applying different Recoil Direction attachments attaches different muzzle attachments to the weapon. These differ by weapon type, and include Muzzle Brakes, Compensators, and Flash Hiders.

Echidna is a recurring character of the Disney animated series Hercules. She is the "Mother of All Monsters" of every horrifying creature to appear in the series. She is also the wife of the monstrous Titan, Typhon.
Dusty Crophopper is the protagonist of the 2013 Disneytoon Studios animated feature film Planes and its 2014 sequel.

The Sterling submachine gun is British submachine gun. Intended to be a replacement for the Sten submachine gun, it was designed by William Patchett with tests taking place between 1944 and 1945. The prototype that first saw combat by British Airborne troops was designated the Patchett Machine Carbine Mk 1. Despite this, the Sterling did not replace the Sten until 1953 and remained in use until 1994, itself being replaced by the L85A1.
Dyson is Clu's highest-ranking and deadliest soldier. Originally he was a security program created by Kevin Flynn, working to keep order on the Grid, alongside his old friend, Tron.

Durga is a character that appears in Sanjay's Super Team. She is Sanjay's superhero re-imagining of the Hindu goddess Durga. Her superhero identity takes inspiration from the Marvel Comics character Iron Man.

Edward Lipsky, better known as Motor Ed is an automotive-themed supervillain featured on Kim Possible. He is a hard-rocking, car-customizing, mullet-headed, fast-driving madman on the road to destruction.

Recoil is the backward movement of a gun when it is fired. Recoil causes the user's aim to shift as the gun pushes back at the user. In the Battlefield series, recoil is a major aspect of weapon property.

Elastico, also known as Experiment 345, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to distract hostile forces with his clownish antics and elastic body. His one true place is with the circus.
The Electric Eels are the pets and minions of Marina Del Rey and the secondary antagonists from The Little Mermaid: Ariel's Beginning.

Ellen Brandt is a Marvel Comics character that appears in Iron Man 3. She was a war veteran turned assassin after her exposure to the virus Extremis. Ellen Brandt was created by Roy Thomas, Gerry Conway, and Gray Morrow.

A is a modification of a regular crossbow that involves combining the stringing of the bow, placing the bolt and firing the projectile with a single hand movement, facilitating higher rates of fire than regular crossbows. Repeating crossbows were designed and used in China circa 400-500 BC and utilized until 1912. Repeating crossbows often contained a magazine of arrows affixed on top of the crossbow, which are then fed into the bow-string ready to fire via gravity and the operation of a lever to cycle the bolt.

Elektra Natchios is a character from Marvel Comics who appears in Daredevil, played by Élodie Yung. She is an assassin who was sent to kill Daredevil. However, she fell in love with him, and couldn't bring herself to kill him. She now acts an anti-heroic ally of Daredevil, helping him defeat his enemies. She is an expert martial artist and she uses a pair of sais as weapons. Elektra Natchios was created by Frank Miller.

Edalyn "Eda" Clawthorne (also known as "The Owl Lady") is one of the deuteragonists of the Disney Channel animated series The Owl House. She is a powerful rebellious witch who befriends Luz Noceda and takes her on as her witch apprentice.

Eleanor Fay Bloomingbottom is the main protagonist of the 2020 Disney+ film Godmothered. She is a fairy godmother-in-training, who hails from the Motherland and arrives in the real world to help Mackenzie Walsh, a single mom facing a midlife crisis.

The Plasma Forty-Five is a submachine gun featured in Battlefield Heroes for the National Army. It was introduced to coincide with the release of Lunar Landing. The weapon is statistically and functionally identical as the Space-night Special for the Royal Army. It is only available for the Soldier kit, it releases laser energy once fired to deal damage at short to medium ranges. BFH Plasma Forty-Five.jpg BFH Laser Rifles Promo.jpg

Erin Catherine Torpey is an American actress and singer, who is best known for her roles as Jessica Buchanan and Megan Rappaport in the ABC soap opera One Life to Live from 1990 to 2003 and in 2008, respectively. For Disney, she was the former speaking voice of Princess Aurora (whom was originally voiced by Mary Costa in Sleeping Beauty, who she voiced from 2007, until she was succeeded by Jennifer Hale (who also currently voices Cinderella after replacing Ilene Woods) in 2009. She also voiced Invisible Woman in The Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes and played Arlene French/Betty Carver in two episodes of Agent Carter.
Evil Jake is a minor character from the television show American Dragon: Jake Long.

Evanora, the Wicked Witch of the East, is the main antagonist of Disney's 2013 fantasy film Oz the Great and Powerful. A witch to be feared, Evanora is Theodora's over-protective sister. With her penetrating gaze, she exudes a powerful presence and has positioned herself as the royal adviser and protector of the Emerald City.

The PzF 44 2A1 (also known as Leichte Panzerfaust, or Panzerfaust 2) is a recoilless anti-tank weapon. It was originally developed around 1960 and put into service by the Bundeswehr in 1963 before being replaced by the Panzerfaust 3 in 1992. It was the first German antitank rocket developed after World War II and had many similarities with the Panzerfaust.
The Fairies are magical creatures that appear in the film Maleficent and live in the magical forest known as the Moors.

Fairy Fawn is a character created by Guido Martina and Romano Scarpa, appearing in the comic story "The Captive Fairy's Quest" in 1959 (translated and collected by Fantagraphics in 2024). The evil Queen Grimhilde, furious with Snow White's happiness, conjures a magical storm and throws a lightning bolt at the young princess. However, a nearby fawn leaps in front of the attack, saving Snow White's life. The Seven Dwarfs later learn the fawn was actually the Fairy Fawn, a beautiful fairy that became imprisoned by the Evil Queen. She agrees to help the Dwarfs in their mission to free her. After a lengthy adventure, Dopey manages to save Fairy Fawn at the cost of his own life. The fairy leaves Queen Grimhilde to perish under falling debris. In her fawn form, she guides Snow White to the Dwarfs, who are mourning Dopey. Snow White's kisses and tears restore Dopey back to life.
Fenton Crackshell (also known as Gizmoduck) is a character who was introduced in the second season of DuckTales. He later made guest appearances in its spin-off Darkwing Duck.

The Rigid-hull Inflatable Boat (RHIB) is a high speed insertion naval craft primarily used by the United States Navy SEALs and the United States Marine Corps. The boat is an 11-meter (36 ft) craft that has a capacity of almost 8,000 kg (17,400 lbs) and can hold a crew of three and up to eight passengers for a full squad of SEALs or Marines and all their equipment to be quickly inserted to the shore. The craft has a maximum speed of 45 knots (83 km/h) and can operate in winds up to the same speed, but it is normally deployed in fairer weather, as well as having an average cruise speed of around 33 knots (61 km/h) and a range of 200 nautical miles (370 km). The boat is usually lightly armed, only carrying a forward facing M2 Browning heavy machine gun, an Mk 19 40mm Grenade Launcher, or an M240B general purpose machine gun.
